note: Single source of every model parameter. Provenance: SRC (URL read in this session), REPO (path in this repo), INF (own inference/textbook), UNMEASURED (placeholder, must be measured on the bench), MEASURED_SIM (from a tests/sim run), MEASURED_HW (a bench overlay). Override without code changes: MODEL_PARAMS=<file>, MODEL_MEASURED=<overlay.json>, MODEL_SET='key=val;key=val', or --set key=val.

video.description: Video stream shared by the RF and latency models
assumptions: constant average bitrate with an I-frame ratio
one RTP packet per wfb-ng data fragment

iframe_ratio.note: placeholder, range is INF. I-frame size / average frame size; majestic GOP not read

rf.description: RF link: path loss, SNR, PER per MCS, wfb-ng FEC residual loss
assumptions: single link, line-of-sight with a log-distance exponent; no terrain, no Fresnel, no antenna pattern
thermal noise -174 dBm/Hz + 10log10(BW) + NF; interference is an additive power term
PER from the ns-3 NIST union-bound BER with the 802.11 K=7 convolutional code (BCC); real chips are worse by implementation_loss_db
frame losses independent (iid) or a 2-state Gilbert burst model; blocks independent of each other
FEC: block of n fragments, k data; a lost data packet is recovered iff at most n-k fragments of the block are lost (MDS code)
SNR is the per-subcarrier SNR = total SNR over the channel (flat channel, no frequency selectivity)
no rate adaptation, no retries (wfb-ng broadcasts without ACK)

freq_mhz.note: any 5 GHz channel centre; only enters the path-loss formula (+20log10 f)

vht.note: master.cfg force_vht=False; vht=false => HT MCS 0..7, true => VHT MCS 0..9 (9 invalid at 20 MHz 1SS)

stbc.note: master.cfg [base] stbc=1 (0 = off); only changes HT-LTF count in the airtime formula

ldpc.note: master.cfg [base] ldpc=1 (8812au only, both ends). The BCC union bound is used for PER; LDPC advantage is the separate ldpc_gain_db

fec_n.note: master.cfg [video] fec_n=12 (README FAQ: recovers 4 lost packets of 12)

tx_power_dbm.note: placeholder, range is INF. conducted power at the antenna port; wfb-ng author could not measure it (HOWTO Note1)

tx_antenna_gain_dbi.note: placeholder, range is INF. datasheet of the actual antenna, not of the adapter

rx_antenna_gain_dbi.note: placeholder, range is INF. datasheet of the actual antenna

misc_loss_db.note: placeholder, range is INF. cables, connectors, polarisation mismatch, body shadow

noise_figure_db.note: placeholder, range is INF. RX noise figure of RTL8812AU/EU front end; no datasheet number was read

implementation_loss_db.note: placeholder, range is INF. gap between the ideal union-bound receiver (ns-3 NIST model) and the real chip

mcs_snr_offset_db.note: placeholder, range is INF. per-MCS correction (index = MCS) added on top of implementation_loss_db; fit from the measured SNR at 10 % PER

ldpc_gain_db.note: placeholder, range is INF. extra SNR credit when ldpc=1; 0 = neutral

diversity_gain_db.note: placeholder, range is INF. STBC / 2-antenna RX diversity credit; 0 = neutral

path_loss_exponent.note: 2.0 = free space (textbook). Obstructed/ground-level links need 2.7..3.5; fit on the bench

ref_distance_m.note: log-distance reference d0; PL(d0) is the free-space value

fading_model.note: none | rayleigh | rician (per-frame independent, unit-mean power gain)

rician_k_db.note: placeholder, range is INF. Rician K factor when fading_model=rician

fading_draws.note: number of fixed (seeded) fading draws, common random numbers across distances

interference_dbm.note: placeholder, range is INF. co-channel/in-band interference power at the RX antenna, added to thermal noise; null = none. Measure the noise floor with the TX off

floor_per.note: placeholder, range is INF. non-RF frame loss floor (USB drops, driver ENOBUFS, CPU) added as independent loss

loss_model.note: iid | ge (Gilbert: good=no loss, bad=all lost)

ge_mean_burst_frames.note: placeholder, range is INF. mean bad-run length for loss_model=ge; fit from the loss-run histogram

payload_bytes.note: rtph264pay/rtph265pay mtu=1400; one RTP packet = one wfb-ng data fragment

wfb_overhead_bytes.note: 802.11 header 24 + wblock_hdr 9 (packed) + wpacket_hdr 3 + FCS 4 (INF) + chacha20poly1305 tag 16 (libsodium ABYTES, INF, not re-read)

mac_access_us.note: placeholder, range is INF. per-frame DIFS + mean backoff before injection (34 + 7.5*9 = ~100 us if the normal EDCA path applies; whether injection bypasses it is not verified)

target_residual.note: residual video-packet loss threshold for max range (task requirement: <1 %)

max_search_m.note: upper bound of the range search

relay_jitter_ms.note: placeholder, range is INF. std-dev of per-frame delay fed to air_relay --jitter-ms (USB + scheduling)

relay_extra_delay_ms.note: placeholder, range is INF. fixed extra delay on top of airtime (USB, driver queue)

calibration.measure: conducted TX power at the antenna connector, at the txpower used in the test
calibration.command: iw dev wlan0 info | grep txpower   (requested power only; the actual value needs a meter)
calibration.tool: RF power meter + attenuator, or SDR with a calibrated tap
calibration.how: Measure in monitor mode with wfb_tx running a steady stream. If no meter: fit tx_power_dbm from RSSI at 3 distances with the other gains fixed (see rf-pathloss).

calibration.command: datasheet; or cabled RSSI vs radiated RSSI at 1 m
calibration.how: Cabled test with a fixed attenuator removes the antenna from the chain.

calibration.measure: noise floor with the TX off, and interference
calibration.command: iw dev wlan0 survey dump  (noise field; support by the 8812au driver is UNVERIFIED);  tshark -i wlan0 -T fields -e radiotap.dbm_antnoise
calibration.how: noise_figure_db = noise_dbm - (-174 + 10*log10(BW_Hz)); a floor above the thermal value is interference_dbm.

calibration.measure: RSSI vs distance at fixed MCS in an open field (>=5 distances)
calibration.command: wfb-cli gs   (RSSI per antenna);  tshark -i wlan0 -T fields -e radiotap.dbm_antsignal -e radiotap.mcs.index -e frame.time_relative
calibration.how: Least-squares fit of rx_dbm = A - 10*n*log10(d); n goes to rf.path_loss_exponent.

calibration.measure: SNR needed for 10 % PER per MCS (attenuator sweep or distance sweep)
calibration.command: wfb_tx -p 0 ... with fixed MCS, then 'iperf3 -u -b <rate> -c <peer>' through the wfb-ng tunnel (stream 0x20/0xa0) and wfb-cli gs for lost/recovered counters
calibration.how: Raw frame loss before FEC = lost + recovered counters in wfb-cli. Offset per MCS = measured SNR@10%PER - model SNR@10%PER.

calibration.measure: run-length histogram of lost frames at a stable SNR
calibration.command: wfb-cli gs (counters) or tcpdump -i wlan0 -w cap.pcap and a sequence-number gap script
calibration.how: Mean bad-run length -> ge_mean_burst_frames; loss at very high SNR -> floor_per.

calibration.measure: inter-frame spacing of injected frames on air
calibration.command: tshark -i wlan0 -T fields -e frame.time_delta_displayed -e frame.len on a second adapter in monitor mode
calibration.how: Gap minus the frame airtime = access time; its std-dev -> relay_jitter_ms.

calibration.command: ffprobe -show_frames -select_streams v capture.h265 | grep pkt_size   or  wfb-cli gs (bytes/s)

power.description: 5 V budget, USB budget and brown-out risk per Raspberry Pi board
assumptions: static currents per state; the transient (inrush, TX pulse) is a single peak factor
supply sag = nominal - I_total * R_cable (one lumped resistance)
the documented 'maximum total USB peripheral current' is treated as a hard budget; the real limiter behaviour (per-port fuse? shared?) is not documented
fan, CSI camera and GPIO loads count against the PSU but not against the USB budget

undervolt_threshold_v.note: low-voltage detection circuitry trips below 4.63 V (+-5 %) on all models except the Zero range

cable_resistance_ohm.note: placeholder, range is INF. PSU cable + connector + board input path (round trip); thin cables give 0.2+ ohm

margin_warn_frac.note: warn when PSU headroom < 20 % of the rating

usb_dropout_v.note: placeholder, range is INF. board-rail voltage at which a USB device is assumed to reset (no number found); drives brownout fault injection only

usb_reenum_s.note: placeholder, range is INF. time from a USB drop to the device being usable again (enumeration + driver + wfb-ng restart)

tx_peak_factor.note: placeholder, range is INF. pulse/average current ratio of the adapter in TX (HOWTO: 1.6 A in pulse for ~1.1 A average is NOT stated; ratio is a guess)

calibration.measure: board-rail voltage under load and cable resistance
calibration.command: vcgencmd pmic_read_adc  (EXT5V_V; Pi 5, output format UNVERIFIED); multimeter on the 5 V test points; vcgencmd get_throttled; dmesg | grep -i voltage
calibration.how: R = (V_nominal_at_PSU - V_board) / I_total. usb_dropout_v: slowly lower the supply voltage on a bench PSU until the adapter drops (NOT with the aircraft connected).

assumptions: terms add linearly; max is the sum of per-term maxima (a bound, not a percentile)
wfb-ng sends data fragments immediately (tx.cpp) so FEC block wait only exists when a fragment is lost
hardware decoder latency = per-frame processing + (reorder + queue) frames; the numbers are placeholders
software decode is scaled from the x86 simulation (MEASURED_SIM) by pixels and a CPU ratio
display = vblank wait + scan-out + panel + queued frames; sync=false page flips

capture_frames.note: placeholder, range is INF. exposure + sensor readout + ISP of the OpenIPC camera (air side), in frame periods

encode_frames.note: placeholder, range is INF. SoC encoder latency in frame periods (slice-based low-delay can be < 1)

usb_rx_ms.note: placeholder, range is INF. wfb_rx pcap + USB bulk RX + wfb_rx FEC/decrypt on the GS

network_ms.note: placeholder, range is INF. wfb_rx -> UDP -> host (loopback or LAN)

jitterbuffer_ms.note: the bench pipeline has no rtpjitterbuffer (value 0); docs/CHAINS.md proposes latency=10, 20 is a common choice (not confirmed)

vsync_wait_frac.note: mean wait for the next vblank = half a refresh with sync=false page flips (INF)

scanout_frac.note: time from vblank to the measured spot = half a refresh for mid-screen

panel_ms.note: placeholder, range is INF. pixel response + monitor/TV processing

display_queue_frames.note: placeholder, range is INF. extra frames queued in sink/compositor (kmssink vs waylandsink)

sw_ref_h264_ms.note: tests/sim/video_latency.py x86 loopback 640x360@30: min 3 / p50 5 / p95 10 / max 30 ms; INCLUDES the x264 encode (software enc+dec), not a Pi figure

sw_ref_h265_ms.note: same run: h265 min 6 / p50 8 / p95 15 / max 41 ms (x265 encode + decode)

sw_decode_fraction.note: placeholder, range is INF. decode share of the encode+decode sim time

cpu_scale_vs_x86.note: placeholder, range is INF. Pi 5 (A76) vs the x86 CI runner, single stream
